what: A collage piece stays still until 80% of one cycle (default 6s), then pinches to .98x twice at 90% and 94%, pop, pop, and returns to place at 96%. Varying length (6~6.6s) and delay (.3~2.8s) per piece makes the photos on the flowing strip breathe at different tempos

options.--fx-dur: One cycle (via style), default 6s — Brand pieces each use 6·6.2·6.5·6.6s

note: It uses the whole transform, so for elements that already have a translate applied, attach it to an inner wrapper

from.where: index.html .rz-hero__main .swiper-slide > .rz-piece — original CSS kodo 6s ease-out infinite (steps at 80~96%, scale .98 at 90 · 94%), each piece has animation-duration 6~6.6s · delay .3~2.8s
